scripts.panelPrompt: How does Luna Sky compare with other artists in the UK?
scripts.heading: Compared with the 9 other artists in the UK top 10
scripts.answer: Luna Sky is #2 of the UK top 10 by capped streams (6.92M) and #2 for growth (+6% against a median of +2.5%). Only Odalie Brask is ahead on both.
scripts.how: Artists in this table, UK only, W42 vs W41, top 100k access.

scripts.panelPrompt: Which markets is Luna Sky growing faster than the market in?
scripts.heading: Luna Sky growth vs each market, W42 vs W41
scripts.answer: Luna Sky grew faster than the market in 8 of 10 markets, level in the UK and slower only in Mexico. The biggest gap is Germany (+7 pts).
scripts.how: Artist and market capped streams, W42 vs W41, all markets in your access.
scripts.note_FOR_DEV: Do not invent a reason for Germany. The follow-up 'Why is Germany higher?' must use the fallback line: 'I can show what changed, not why. Try: which songs drove it?'

scripts.panelPrompt: Is my dip this week just me, or the whole market?
scripts.subject: Petra Lindqvane (Quillfern roster)
scripts.heading: Petra Lindqvane vs the UK market, W42 vs W41
scripts.answer: It is mostly you: the UK grew +6% and 7 of the UK top 10 artists grew, while Petra Lindqvane fell 4%, the biggest fall in the top 10. Autumn Phillips (-1%) and David Elson (-2%) also dipped, so a small part is wider.

scripts.panelPrompt: Is the UK growing faster than France this quarter?
scripts.heading: UK vs France, Q3 vs Q2
scripts.answer: Yes. The UK grew 11.4% quarter on quarter against 2.3% for France, and the UK grew in 10 of the last 13 weeks against 6 for France.
